recognize_zh: 周邊血中同時看到嗜鹼性球（深色粗顆粒蓋住核）、含粗顆粒且核未分葉的未成熟顆粒球，以及分葉與帶狀嗜中性球，這種「各階段顆粒球加上嗜鹼性球」的組合是 CML 的周邊血表現。
features: Two basophils with dense dark granules obscuring the nucleus (top and left-center)
Two large immature granulocytes (myelocyte/metamyelocyte) with indented nuclei and abundant granular cytoplasm at right
Red cells with target-like and stomatocyte-like forms and occasional crenated cells, partly drying artifact
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a left-shifted granulocytic population including immature granulocytes (myelocytes/metamyelocytes) with abundant granular cytoplasm, band and segmented neutrophils, and two basophils. No blasts are seen in this field. Red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with target-like and stomatocyte-like forms, some attributable to drying artifact, and platelets are present in small clumps. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia with basophilia; in the clinical context of relapse, correlation with blast and basophil percentages is needed to stage the disease.

ddx.vs: Leukemoid reactions show toxic granulation and Dohle bodies with no basophilia and are BCR::ABL1 negative.
aCML shows prominent dysgranulopoiesis without significant basophilia and lacks BCR::ABL1.
CNL is dominated by mature segmented neutrophils with immature granulocytes <10%, no basophilia, and CSF3R mutation.
